preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Balance Sheet Table'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: (select acc_gl_account.gl_code as 'glcode', acc_gl_account.name as 'name', (case acc_gl_account.classification_enum when 1 then 'Assets' when 2 then 'Liability' when 3 then 'Equity' end) as 'BalanceType', (case acc_gl_account.classification_enum when 1 then sum(case when acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum=2 then acc_gl_journal_entry.amount else 0 end) - sum(case when acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum=1 then acc_gl_journal_entry.amount else 0 end) else sum(case when acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum=1 then acc_gl_journal_entry.amount else 0 end) - sum(case when acc_gl_journal_entry.type_enum=2 then acc_gl_journal_entry.amount else 0 end) end) as 'balance' from acc_gl_journal_entry inner join acc_gl_account on acc_gl_account.id = acc_gl_journal_entry.account_id where acc_gl_account.classification_enum in (1,2,3) and acc_gl_journal_entry.entry_date <= date('${endDate}') and (acc_gl_journal_entry.office_id=${officeId} or ${officeId}=1) group by acc_gl_account.gl_code, acc_gl_account.name, acc_gl_account.classification_enum)
